blocks.text: 开过 PR 的人都懂这套流程。刚动手做下一件事，评审意见就回来了。于是只好停下来，翻回旧代码，推一个修复，再等评审重新跑一遍。然后还得去找人批准。

inlines.text: 开过 PR 的人都懂这套流程。刚动手做下一件事，评审意见就回来了。于是只好停下来，翻回旧代码，推一个修复，再等评审重新跑一遍。然后还得去找人批准。

blocks.text: 这种流程有其道理。多数团队希望每个改动都由人来批准，当每一行代码都是人写的时候，这很容易做到。但现在很多开发者用智能体写代码。在 Claude Code 团队，大部分代码都是 Claude 写的，我们希望 PR 之后的环节也能同样快。

blocks.text: PR Steward 负责让 PR 保持通过状态，但它的设计目标是不批准、不合并 PR。当 CI 检查失败、出现合并冲突，或收到来自 Code Review、其他评审工具及团队成员的评审意见时，它会介入处理。每次推送后，它都会评论说明改了什么、如何撤销。开发者可以评论 @claude 并附上指令来引导它的工作，或评论 @claude stop 让它退后一步。

blocks.text: Anyone who has opened a pull request knows how this goes. They start on the next thing, and then the review comes back. So they stop, dig back into the old code, push a fix, and wait for the review to run again. Then they go find someone to approve it.

inlines.text: Anyone who has opened a pull request knows how this goes. They start on the next thing, and then the review comes back. So they stop, dig back into the old code, push a fix, and wait for the review to run again. Then they go find someone to approve it.

blocks.text: There's a good reason it works this way. Most teams want a person to approve every change, and that's easy to keep up with when people write every line. But a lot of developers build with agents now. On the Claude Code team, Claude writes most of our code, and we wanted everything after the PR to move that fast too.

inlines.text: There's a good reason it works this way. Most teams want a person to approve every change, and that's easy to keep up with when people write every line. But a lot of developers build with agents now. On the Claude Code team,

blocks.text: That's why we built Claude Ship, available today in beta. It can review PRs, fix them, and decide what's ready to merge based on policies each team sets. Teams stay in control of where it runs and which changes need a person. The goal: ship code as fast as teams write it.

How Claude Ship works: review, fix, and approve

inlines.text: How Claude Ship works: review, fix, and approve

blocks.text: Claude Ship is made up of Code Review, which is already generally available, and two new agents in beta: PR Steward and Claude Approvals. Together, they take a pull request through review, fixes, and an approval decision so teams don't have to manage each step manually.

blocks.alt: Claude Ship helps teams review PRs, fix them, and decides what's ready to merge. Claude Ship uses AI and may miss bugs, security vulnerabilities, or other issues.

blocks.text: Code Review performs an in-depth review of pull requests against the codebase through multiple lenses. It collects findings, adversarially verifies them, categorizes them, and posts them to a PR. On the Claude Code team, where Claude's review is one layer of a broader process, merged PRs more than doubled from June to September while the share reverted fell by more than 40%. Code Review gives teams fast reviews, clear findings, and a choice of Quick, Standard, or Deep review levels for each repository.

blocks.text: PR Steward works to keep a PR green, but is designed not to approve or merge pull requests. It jumps in on failing CI checks, merge conflicts, and review feedback from Code Review, other review tools, or team members. After every push, it comments with what it changed and how to undo it. Developers can comment @claude with an instruction to steer the work, or @claude stop to have it step back.

blocks.text: From there, Claude Approvals applies an approval policy that the team writes as a file in the repository. Claude can approve routine changes on its own if the policy allows it, or can require deeper human sign-off for certain scenarios. It works like a smarter CODEOWNERS file. Teams can have Claude Approvals consider a variety of signals in its decision-making process, including Code Review findings or their own classifiers using natural language. For most customers, we recommend enabling this first in observe-only mode to build confidence before configuring branch protection to require Claude Approvals' green light.

inlines.text: Availability

blocks.text: Claude Ship is available on Claude Team and Enterprise plans for repositories on GitHub. Code Review is generally available, and PR Steward and Claude Approvals are in beta.

inlines.text: Claude Ship is available on Claude Team and Enterprise plans for repositories on GitHub. Code Review is
generally available
, and PR Steward and Claude Approvals are in beta.

blocks.text: Claude Ship usage is billed on tokens, so turning it on can add to an organization’s costs. The amount depends on the number and size of pull requests covered, the review level, how often reviews run, and how much work PR Steward does. Admins can set spend limits for Code Review and PR Steward. Claude Approvals has no base charge, but classifiers in a policy are billed on the tokens they use, and a policy that uses Claude's review triggers a billed Code Review, even in observe mode. Running /ship counts as regular Claude Code usage.

blocks.text: Claude Ship is not available to organizations with Zero Data Retention, the HIPAA configuration, or customer-managed encryption keys.
